task_selection: Core first, then lexical overlap with target D text, then Task ID

occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: These workers are the primary users, or "agents," who use the software to manage customer communications across email, live chat, phone, and social media from a single inbox to track and resolve support requests ([D:LiveAgent:landing:1], [D:LiveAgent:landing:2]).

tasks.text: Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services, take or enter orders, cancel accounts, or obtain details of complaints.
Complete contract forms, prepare change of address records, or issue service discontinuance orders, using computers.
Check to ensure that appropriate changes were made to resolve customers' problems.
Contact customers to respond to inquiries or to notify them of claim investigation results or any planned adjustments.

occupations.title: Computer User Support Specialists
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: As these specialists provide technical help, they would use LiveAgent's help desk features to automatically turn user messages into tickets and track and resolve every request ([D:LiveAgent:landing:2]).

tasks.text: Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
Set up equipment for employee use, performing or ensuring proper installation of cables, operating systems, or appropriate software.
Read technical manuals, confer with users, or conduct computer diagnostics to investigate and resolve problems or to provide technical assistance and support.
Develop training materials and procedures, or train users in the proper use of hardware or software.

occupations.title: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: These supervisors would oversee teams of customer service agents, using LiveAgent's features to handle calls, track conversations, and manage agent performance, with pricing structured on a per-agent basis ([D:LiveAgent:landing:4], [D:LiveAgent:landing:7]).

tasks.text: Resolve customer complaints or answer customers' questions regarding policies and procedures.
Provide employees with guidance in handling difficult or complex problems or in resolving escalated complaints or disputes.
Discuss job performance problems with employees to identify causes and issues and to work on resolving problems.
Make recommendations to management concerning such issues as staffing decisions or procedural changes.
